summary: The note argues that parents and coaches together shape healthy habits in youth athletes, as of late 2023. It covers parental support, coach education, managing pressure, nutrition, injury prevention and mental toughness. It concludes that holistic well-being, not winning, is becoming the measure of success in youth sports.
one_line: Parents and coaches jointly foster youth athletes' healthy habits through support, education, nutrition, safety and mental conditioning, prioritizing well-being over winning.
key_facts: On Saturday, October 7th, 2023, the bleachers at Elmwood Park overflowed with spectators at a youth sports event.
Sarah Jennings, mother of 12-year-old Mia, volunteers at the concession stand and wants to teach Mia the value of commitment to her team and goals.
James Donovan is head of the Riverdale Youth Soccer Club.
Riverdale coaches underwent a mandatory development workshop on September 15th covering nutritional education and psychological resilience.
Dr. Angela Foster, a child sports psychologist, said at the Community Youth Sports Symposium on November 12th, 2023 that overemphasis on winning can lead to undue pressure and negative stress.
On November 21st, the regional youth athletics association hosted a seminar led by sports nutritionist Emily Torres on diet's impact on performance, recovery and overall health.
Michael Thompson, father of 14-year-old track hopeful Eric, said Emily Torres's advice helped his family adopt healthier eating habits overall.
Jennifer Lee, a local physiotherapist, says injury prevention starts with education so athletes learn to listen to their bodies and speak up.
Coach-led clinics on safe sport techniques and injury prevention have become the norm after a recent push for athlete safety from local and national sports governing bodies.
Parents and coaches support mental toughness by modeling responses to disappointment, giving feedback focused on effort and improvement, and stressing teamwork and sportsmanship.
The note says habits like discipline, persistence, teamwork and self-care learned through sports transcend the playing field.
